name: Vesper Republic
summary: A young revolutionary republic built around citizenship, public argument, inquiry and the belief that institutions must justify themselves.
gateAttitude: Vesper strongly resists monopolies over magical knowledge.
beliefs: Vesper follows the **Vesperian Communion** of the Faith of the First Light, also called the **Sacred Flame**, which emphasizes conscience, inquiry, creation, liberty and the divine Spark shared by thinking beings. It shares older myths with Aurelia's Crowned Sun but reads them differently. Vesper abolished, marginalized or absorbed much of its older belief system; traces of it linger in fairy tales, urban legends, festivals, folk customs and place names.
visualSummary: Belle Époque and Art Nouveau modernity, with posters, iron, glass, civic symbolism and experimental technology.

relations.text: Shares the Faith of the First Light, read differently.
